```{ojs}
//| echo: false
buildQuiz = function(id, title, questions) {
  const outer = html`<div id="${id}" style="margin:18px 0 24px 0;text-align:center;">
    <button style="
      display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea 0%,#764ba2 100%);
      color:#fff;border:none;padding:9px 22px;border-radius:50px;
      font-size:.95em;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;
      box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(102,126,234,.45);
      transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s;"
      onmouseover="this.style.transform='scale(1.04)';this.style.boxShadow='0 5px 18px rgba(102,126,234,.55)'"
      onmouseout="this.style.transform='scale(1)';this.style.boxShadow='0 3px 12px rgba(102,126,234,.45)'"
    >
      <span style="font-size:1.1em;">📝</span> ${title}
      <span class="chevron" style="transition:transform .3s;">▼</span>
    </button>
    <div class="quiz-body" style="
      max-height:0;opacity:0;overflow:hidden;
      transition:max-height .5s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),opacity .4s ease,margin-top .3s ease;
      margin-top:0;text-align:left;">
      <button class="close-btn" style="
        display:block;margin:0 auto 10px auto;
        background:rgba(102,126,234,.12);color:#667eea;border:none;
        padding:5px 18px;border-radius:50px;font-size:.85em;
        font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Hide Quiz</button>
      <p style="text-align:center;color:#718096;font-style:italic;font-size:.9em;margin-bottom:12px;">
        Select an answer for each question.</p>
    </div>
  </div>`;
  const toggle = outer.querySelector("button");
  const chevron = toggle.querySelector(".chevron");
  const body   = outer.querySelector(".quiz-body");
  const closeBtn = body.querySelector(".close-btn");
  function expand(){  body.style.maxHeight="2000px";body.style.opacity="1";body.style.marginTop="14px";chevron.style.transform="rotate(180deg)"; }
  function collapse(){ body.style.maxHeight="0";body.style.opacity="0";body.style.marginTop="0";chevron.style.transform="rotate(0)"; }
  toggle.onclick = () => body.style.maxHeight === "0px" || body.style.maxHeight === "" ? expand() : collapse();
  closeBtn.onclick = collapse;
  questions.forEach((qq, qi) => {
    const card = document.createElement("div");
    card.style.cssText = "background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:16px 20px;margin-bottom:14px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.08);";
    card.innerHTML = `<p style="font-weight:700;margin:0 0 10px;">${qi+1}. ${qq.q}</p>`;
    qq.options.forEach((opt, oi) => {
      const btn = document.createElement("button");
      btn.textContent = opt;
      btn.style.cssText = "display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:10px 14px;margin:6px 0;border:2px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;cursor:pointer;font-size:.95em;transition:border-color .2s,background .2s;";
      btn.onmouseover = () => { if(!card.dataset.answered){ btn.style.borderColor="#667eea";btn.style.background="#f0f0ff"; }};
      btn.onmouseout  = () => { if(!card.dataset.answered){ btn.style.borderColor="#e2e8f0";btn.style.background="#fff"; }};
      btn.onclick = () => {
        if(card.dataset.answered) return;
        card.dataset.answered = "true";
        card.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => { b.style.cursor="default"; b.onmouseover=null; b.onmouseout=null; });
        if(oi === qq.correct){
          btn.style.borderColor="#48bb78";btn.style.background="#f0fff4";
          fb.innerHTML = "✅ Correct! " + qq.explanation;
          fb.style.color="#276749";fb.style.background="#f0fff4";
        } else {
          btn.style.borderColor="#fc8181";btn.style.background="#fff5f5";
          card.querySelectorAll("button")[qq.correct].style.borderColor="#48bb78";
          card.querySelectorAll("button")[qq.correct].style.background="#f0fff4";
          fb.innerHTML = "❌ " + qq.explanation;
          fb.style.color="#9b2c2c";fb.style.background="#fff5f5";
        }
        fb.style.padding="10px 14px";fb.style.marginTop="8px";
      };
      card.appendChild(btn);
    });
    const fb = document.createElement("div");
    fb.style.cssText = "border-radius:8px;font-size:.9em;transition:all .3s;";
    card.appendChild(fb);
    body.appendChild(card);
  });
  return outer;
}
```

```{ojs}
    options: ["A) Full Moon", "B) First Quarter", "C) New Moon", "D) Third Quarter"],
    correct: 2,
    explanation: "October 29, 2012 was a New Moon — the Moon was positioned between Earth and the Sun, with its illuminated side facing away from us. This produced a spring tide that elevated the baseline water level before Sandy even arrived."
  },
  {
    q: "Based on the calendar, approximately how long is one complete lunar cycle (New Moon to New Moon)?",
    options: ["A) ~7 days", "B) ~14 days", "C) ~29.5 days", "D) ~365 days"],
    correct: 2,
    explanation: "The synodic lunar cycle takes approximately 29.5 days — the time for the Moon to return to the same phase as seen from Earth."
  },
  {
    q: "How often does a spring tide (New Moon or Full Moon) occur each month?",
    options: ["A) Once per month", "B) Twice per month", "C) Four times per month", "D) Once every three months"],
    correct: 1,
    explanation: "Spring tides occur at every New Moon and every Full Moon — about twice per lunar month, roughly every 14.75 days."
  },
  {
    q: "If Sandy had arrived on October 16 instead of October 29, what moon phase would it have been?",
    options: ["A) New Moon — still a spring tide", "B) First Quarter — a neap tide", "C) Full Moon — still a spring tide", "D) Third Quarter — a neap tide"],
    correct: 2,
    explanation: "October 15 was the Full Moon. Sandy arriving on October 16 would have coincided with a Full Moon — another spring tide configuration, with similarly elevated tidal conditions."
  }
])
```

```{ojs}
  {day: 14.8, phase: "Full Moon", illumination: 100, icon: "🌕"},
  {day: 18.5, phase: "Waning Gibbous", illumination: 87.5, icon: "🌖"},
  {day: 22.1, phase: "Third Quarter", illumination: 50, icon: "🌗"},

Plot.plot({
  title: "Moon Illumination Through One Lunar Cycle",
  subtitle: "The moon takes ~29.5 days to complete one full cycle of phases",
  width: 700,
  height: 360,
  x: {label: "Day of Lunar Cycle", domain: [0, 30]},
  y: {label: "Illumination (%)", domain: [0, 110]},
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(moonPhases, {x: "day", y: "illumination", fill: "#c0c0c0", fillOpacity: 0.2, curve: "natural"}),
    Plot.lineY(moonPhases, {x: "day", y: "illumination", stroke: "#555", strokeWidth: 2.5, curve: "natural"}),
    Plot.dot(moonPhases, {x: "day", y: "illumination", r: 8, fill: d => d.illumination > 50 ? "#f1c40f" : "#555", stroke: "#333", strokeWidth: 1.5}),
    Plot.text(moonPhases, {x: "day", y: "illumination", text: "icon", dy: -22, fontSize: 20}),
    Plot.text(moonPhases.filter(d => d.day === 0 || d.day === 7.4 || d.day === 14.8 || d.day === 22.1),
      {x: "day", y: "illumination", text: "phase", dy: 25, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 600})
  ]
})
```

# Explain 1: The Geometry of Moon Phases

```{=html}
<div id="moon-sim-root"></div>
<script crossorigin src="https://unpkg.com/react@18/umd/react.production.min.js"></script>
<script crossorigin src="https://unpkg.com/react-dom@18/umd/react-dom.production.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/@babel/standalone/babel.min.js"></script>
<script type="text/babel" data-presets="react">
const { useState, useRef } = React;

const getPhaseName = (angleRadians) => {
  let deg = (angleRadians * 180 / Math.PI) % 360;
  if (deg < 0) deg += 360;
  if (deg < 5 || deg > 355) return "New Moon";
  if (deg < 85) return "Waxing Crescent";
  if (deg < 95) return "First Quarter";
  if (deg < 175) return "Waxing Gibbous";
  if (deg < 185) return "Full Moon";
  if (deg < 265) return "Waning Gibbous";
  if (deg < 275) return "Third Quarter";
  return "Waning Crescent";
};

const getPhaseDescription = (phase) => {
  const descriptions = {
    "New Moon": "The Moon is between Earth and the Sun. The side facing us is completely unilluminated.",
    "Waxing Crescent": "A small sliver of the Moon's right side is illuminated as it moves along its orbit.",
    "First Quarter": "The Moon has traveled a quarter of its orbit. We see exactly half of its illuminated side.",
    "Waxing Gibbous": "Most of the Moon is illuminated, continuing to grow toward Full Moon.",
    "Full Moon": "Earth is between the Moon and Sun. The entire side facing us is illuminated.",
    "Waning Gibbous": "The illuminated portion is shrinking, but more than half is still visible on the left.",
    "Third Quarter": "The Moon has traveled three-quarters of its orbit. We see exactly half, now on the left side.",
    "Waning Crescent": "Only a small sliver remains illuminated on the left before the cycle restarts.",
  };
  return descriptions[phase] || "";
};

const MoonPhaseView = ({ angle }) => {
  let a = (angle % (2 * Math.PI) + 2 * Math.PI) % (2 * Math.PI);
  const isWaxing = a > 0 && a < Math.PI;
  const isGibbous = (a > Math.PI / 2 && a < Math.PI) || (a > Math.PI && a < 3 * Math.PI / 2);
  const rx = 99 * Math.abs(Math.cos(a));

  let pathD = "";
  if (a < 0.05 || a > 2 * Math.PI - 0.05) {
    pathD = "";
  } else if (Math.abs(a - Math.PI) < 0.05) {
    pathD = "M 100,1 A 99,99 0 0,1 100,199 A 99,99 0 0,1 100,1";
  } else if (isWaxing) {
    pathD = !isGibbous
      ? `M 100,1 A 99,99 0 0,1 100,199 A ${rx},99 0 0,0 100,1`
      : `M 100,1 A 99,99 0 0,1 100,199 A ${rx},99 0 0,1 100,1`;
  } else {
    pathD = !isGibbous
      ? `M 100,1 A 99,99 0 0,0 100,199 A ${rx},99 0 0,1 100,1`
      : `M 100,1 A 99,99 0 0,0 100,199 A ${rx},99 0 0,0 100,1`;
  }

  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" style={{width: '200px', height: '200px'}}>
      <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="99" fill="#1e293b" />
      <circle cx="60" cy="80" r="15" fill="#0f172a" opacity="0.3" />
      <circle cx="140" cy="120" r="25" fill="#0f172a" opacity="0.3" />
      <circle cx="100" cy="40" r="12" fill="#0f172a" opacity="0.3" />
      <circle cx="70" cy="150" r="18" fill="#0f172a" opacity="0.3" />
      {pathD && <path d={pathD} fill="#fdfbd3" />}
      <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="99" fill="none" stroke="#334155" strokeWidth="1" />
    </svg>
  );
};

function App() {
  const [angle, setAngle] = useState(0);
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
  const svgRef = useRef(null);

  const phaseName = getPhaseName(angle);
  const phaseDescription = getPhaseDescription(phaseName);

  const CX = 200, CY = 200, ORBIT_R = 120, MOON_R = 18;
  const moonX = CX + ORBIT_R * Math.cos(angle);
  const moonY = CY - ORBIT_R * Math.sin(angle);

  const pX = Math.sin(angle);
  const pY = Math.cos(angle);
  const edge1X = moonX + MOON_R * pX;
  const edge1Y = moonY + MOON_R * pY;
  const edge2X = moonX - MOON_R * pX;
  const edge2Y = moonY - MOON_R * pY;

  const handlePointerDown = () => setIsDragging(true);

  const handlePointerMove = (e) => {
    if (!isDragging || !svgRef.current) return;
    const rect = svgRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const scaleX = 400 / rect.width;
    const scaleY = 400 / rect.height;
    const pointerX = (e.clientX - rect.left) * scaleX;
    const pointerY = (e.clientY - rect.top) * scaleY;
    const dx = pointerX - CX;
    const dy = pointerY - CY;
    let newAngle = Math.atan2(-dy, dx);
    if (newAngle < 0) newAngle += 2 * Math.PI;

    const snapPoints = [0, 45, 90, 135, 180, 225, 270, 315].map(d => d * Math.PI / 180);
    const snapThreshold = 10 * Math.PI / 180;
    for (let sp of snapPoints) {
      let diff = Math.abs(newAngle - sp);
      if (diff > Math.PI) diff = 2 * Math.PI - diff;
      if (diff < snapThreshold) { newAngle = sp; break; }
    }
    setAngle(newAngle);
  };

  const handlePointerUp = () => setIsDragging(false);

  const [stars] = useState(() =>
    Array.from({ length: 60 }).map(() => ({
      x: Math.random() * 400, y: Math.random() * 400,
      r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5, opacity: Math.random() * 0.7 + 0.3
    }))
  );

  const positionNumbers = [
    { n: 1, x: 345, y: 215 }, { n: 2, x: 300, y: 100 },
    { n: 3, x: 215, y: 55 },  { n: 4, x: 100, y: 100 },
    { n: 5, x: 55,  y: 215 }, { n: 6, x: 100, y: 310 },
    { n: 7, x: 215, y: 355 }, { n: 8, x: 300, y: 310 },
  ];

  const S = {
    wrap: { background: '#020617', color: '#f1f5f9', padding: '24px',
      fontFamily: "'Inter',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif",
      borderRadius: '16px', margin: '20px 0', boxShadow: '0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)' },
    header: { marginBottom: '28px', textAlign: 'center' },
    title: { fontSize: '1.6rem', fontWeight: '800', margin: '0 0 10px',
      background: 'linear-gradient(to right, #818cf8, #67e8f9)',
      WebkitBackgroundClip: 'text', WebkitTextFillColor: 'transparent', backgroundClip: 'text', lineHeight: '1.25' },
    subtitle: { color: '#94a3b8', maxWidth: '520px', margin: '0 auto', fontSize: '0.88rem', lineHeight: '1.55' },
    grid: { display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr))', gap: '20px', alignItems: 'start' },
    card: { background: '#0f172a', border: '1px solid #1e293b', borderRadius: '14px', padding: '20px',
      boxShadow: '0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center' },
    cardTitle: { fontSize: '1rem', fontWeight: '600', color: '#e2e8f0', marginBottom: '16px',
      display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px', margin: '0 0 16px' },
    hint: { marginTop: '12px', fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#64748b' },
    phaseName: { fontSize: '1.8rem', fontWeight: '700', color: 'white',
      margin: '24px 0 8px', letterSpacing: '0.02em' },
    phaseDesc: { color: '#cbd5e1', maxWidth: '260px', lineHeight: '1.6', fontSize: '0.88rem', textAlign: 'center', margin: 0 },
    angleReadout: { alignSelf: 'flex-end', fontSize: '0.68rem', fontFamily: 'monospace', color: '#334155', marginTop: '12px' },
  };

  return (
    <div style={S.wrap}>
      <div style={S.header}>
        <p style={S.title}>Interactive Moon Phase Simulator</p>
        <p style={S.subtitle}>
          Drag the Moon around its orbit to see how the viewing angle from Earth creates the phases of the Moon.
          The Moon is always half-illuminated by the Sun — only our perspective changes!
        </p>
      </div>

      <div style={S.grid}>

        {/* LEFT: Orbital Diagram */}
        <div style={S.card}>
          <p style={S.cardTitle}>
            <svg style={{width:'18px',height:'18px',flexShrink:0}} fill="none" stroke="#818cf8" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
              <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth="2"
                d="M15 15l-2 5L9 9l11 4-5 2zm0 0l5 5"/>
            </svg>
            Top-Down System View
          </p>

          <div style={{width:'100%', maxWidth:'400px', aspectRatio:'1/1', userSelect:'none', touchAction:'none'}}>
            <svg ref={svgRef} viewBox="0 0 400 400"
              style={{width:'100%',height:'100%',background:'#020617',borderRadius:'12px',display:'block'}}
              onPointerMove={handlePointerMove} onPointerUp={handlePointerUp} onPointerLeave={handlePointerUp}>

              {stars.map((s, i) => <circle key={i} cx={s.x} cy={s.y} r={s.r} fill="white" opacity={s.opacity} />)}

              {[100,140,180,220,260,300].map(y => (
                <g key={y}>
                  <line x1="390" y1={y} x2="340" y2={y} stroke="#fbbf24" strokeWidth="2" strokeDasharray="4 4" opacity="0.6" />
                  <polygon points={`340,${y} 346,${y-3} 346,${y+3}`} fill="#fbbf24" opacity="0.8" />
                </g>
              ))}
              <text x="368" y="205" textAnchor="middle" fill="#fbbf24" fontSize="12" fontWeight="bold">Sun's Rays</text>

              <circle cx={CX} cy={CY} r={ORBIT_R} fill="none" stroke="#334155" strokeWidth="2" strokeDasharray="8 8" />

              {positionNumbers.map(p => (
                <text key={p.n} x={p.x} y={p.y} fill="#475569" fontSize="13" fontWeight="bold" textAnchor="middle">{p.n}</text>
              ))}

              <line x1={CX} y1={CY} x2={edge1X} y2={edge1Y} stroke="#94a3b8" strokeWidth="1" strokeDasharray="4 4" opacity="0.5" />
              <line x1={CX} y1={CY} x2={edge2X} y2={edge2Y} stroke="#94a3b8" strokeWidth="1" strokeDasharray="4 4" opacity="0.5" />

              <circle cx={CX} cy={CY} r="35" fill="#0f172a" />
              <path d={`M ${CX},${CY-35} A 35,35 0 0,1 ${CX},${CY+35} Z`} fill="#3b82f6" />
              <circle cx={CX} cy={CY} r="2" fill="white" />
              <text x={CX+6} y={CY-3} fill="white" fontSize="10" fontWeight="bold">North</text>
              <text x={CX+6} y={CY+9} fill="white" fontSize="10" fontWeight="bold">Pole</text>

              <g transform={`translate(${moonX},${moonY})`}
                style={{cursor: isDragging ? 'grabbing' : 'grab'}}
                onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}>
                {isDragging && <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="24" fill="none" stroke="#818cf8" strokeWidth="2" opacity="0.8" />}
                <path d={`M 0,-${MOON_R} A ${MOON_R},${MOON_R} 0 0,0 0,${MOON_R} Z`} fill="#475569" />
                <path d={`M 0,-${MOON_R} A ${MOON_R},${MOON_R} 0 0,1 0,${MOON_R} Z`} fill="#fdfbd3" />
                <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="30" fill="transparent" />
              </g>
            </svg>
          </div>

          <p style={S.hint}>{isDragging ? "Drag to orbit…" : "Drag the Moon to orbit it around Earth"}</p>
        </div>

        {/* RIGHT: View from Earth */}
        <div style={{...S.card, justifyContent:'center', textAlign:'center', minHeight:'380px', position:'relative'}}>
          <p style={S.cardTitle}>
            <svg style={{width:'18px',height:'18px',flexShrink:0}} fill="none" stroke="#67e8f9" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
              <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth="2" d="M15 12a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z" />
              <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth="2"
                d="M2.458 12C3.732 7.943 7.523 5 12 5c4.478 0 8.268 2.943 9.542 7-1.274 4.057-5.064 7-9.542 7-4.477 0-8.268-2.943-9.542-7z" />
            </svg>
            Perspective from Earth
          </p>

          <MoonPhaseView angle={angle} />

          <p style={S.phaseName}>{phaseName}</p>
          <p style={S.phaseDesc}>{phaseDescription}</p>

          <p style={S.angleReadout}>Angle: {((angle * 180 / Math.PI) % 360).toFixed(1)}°</p>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('moon-sim-root')).render(<App />);
</script>
```

Phases come from our changing viewing angle as the Moon orbits Earth", "C) Earth has no shadow in space, so the classmate is wrong for a different reason", "D) Only the Sun's shadow creates moon phases"],
```{ojs}
    correct: 1,
    explanation: "Earth's shadow falling on the Moon causes a lunar eclipse — a rare event occurring only when the Moon passes through Earth's umbra at a Full Moon near an orbital node. # Explore 2: NYC Tide Heights — October 2012
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
tideData = {
  const data = [];
  for (let day = 1; day <= 31; day++) {
    for (let hour = 0; hour < 24; hour += 0.5) {
      const t = (day - 1) * 24 + hour;
      const semidiurnal = Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * t / 12.42);
      const springNeap = 1 + 0.35 * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * (day - 15) / 14.75);
      const height = semidiurnal * springNeap * 2.5 + 0.3;
      data.push({
        day: day + hour / 24,
        height: Math.round(height * 100) / 100,
        date: `Oct ${day}`
      });
    }
  }
  return data;
}

Plot.plot({
  title: "NYC Tide Heights — October 2012",
  subtitle: "Full Moon (Oct 15) · New Moon + Sandy's Landfall (Oct 29)",
  width: 720,
  height: 420,
  x: {label: "Day of October", domain: [1, 31]},
  y: {label: "Tide Height (feet)", domain: [-4, 5]},
  marks: [
    Plot.lineY(tideData, {x: "day", y: "height", stroke: "#2980b9", strokeWidth: 1.4}),
    Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#777", strokeDasharray: "4,4"}),

    // Full Moon — Oct 15
    Plot.ruleX([15], {stroke: "#f1c40f", strokeWidth: 3}),
    Plot.text([{x: 15, y: 4.6}], {x: "x", y: "y",
      text: () => "🌕 Full Moon\nOct 15", fill: "#f1c40f",
      fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "bold", textAnchor: "middle"}),

    // New Moon — Oct 29
    Plot.ruleX([29], {stroke: "#d0d0d0", strokeWidth: 3}),
    Plot.text([{x: 28.2, y: 4.6}], {x: "x", y: "y",
      text: () => "🌑 New Moon\nOct 29", fill: "#d0d0d0",
      fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "bold", textAnchor: "middle"}),

    // Sandy Landfall — Oct 29.8 (evening)
    Plot.ruleX([29.8], {stroke: "#e74c3c", strokeWidth: 3, strokeDasharray: "8,3"}),
    Plot.text([{x: 30, y: -2.8}], {x: "x", y: "y",
      text: () => "⚠️ SANDY\nLandfall", fill: "#e74c3c",
      fontSize: 13, fontWeight: "bold", textAnchor: "start"}),

    // Neap tide labels
    Plot.text([{x: 7.5, y: 4.4}], {x: "x", y: "y",
      text: () => "Neap Tide", fill: "#3498db", fontSize: 11, fontWeight: "bold", textAnchor: "middle"}),
    Plot.text([{x: 22, y: 4.4}], {x: "x", y: "y",
      text: () => "Neap Tide", fill: "#3498db", fontSize: 11, fontWeight: "bold", textAnchor: "middle"})
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
    correct: 2,
    explanation: "Sandy struck on Oct 29 — the same night as the New Moon spring tide. The already-elevated baseline tide added to the already-massive storm surge, producing the record ~14 ft storm surge at Battery Park."
  },
  {
    q: "In one sentence, how does Moon phase relate to tide height?",
    options: ["A) Tide height is greatest at Quarter Moons and smallest at New/Full Moons", "B) Tide height does not vary with Moon phase — only storms affect ocean levels", "C) Tide height is greatest (spring tides) at New and Full Moons when Sun–Moon gravity aligns, and smallest (neap tides) at Quarter Moons", "D) Tide height peaks once per month, always around the 15th"],
    correct: 2,
    explanation: "Spring tides (New/Full Moon) produce the highest highs and lowest lows because gravitational forces from the Sun and Moon combine. Neap tides (Quarter Moons) have the smallest range as the forces partially cancel."
  }
])
```

```{=html}
<div id="ecl-container" style="background:#020617;color:#f1f5f9;border-radius:16px;margin:20px 0;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.5);font-family:'Inter',-apple-system,sans-serif;overflow:hidden;">

<script>
(function(){
  var tab='solar', prog=0, playing=false, raf=null, t0=0;
  var CY=200, EX=700, ER=60, OR=220, MR=22;

  function moonPos(){
    var deg=tab==='solar'?210-(prog/100)*60:-30+(prog/100)*60;
    var r=deg*Math.PI/180;
    return {x:EX+OR*Math.cos(r), y:CY+OR*Math.sin(r)};
  }

  function getShadow(cx,cy,r,ul,sp,fd){
    var dx=cx+50, dy=cy-CY, d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
    var ux=dx/d, uy=dy/d, nx=-uy, ny=ux;
    var t1x=cx+nx*r, t1y=cy+ny*r, t2x=cx-nx*r, t2y=cy-ny*r;
    return {
      u:[t1x,t1y,cx+ux*ul,cy+uy*ul,t2x,t2y].join(','),
      p:[t1x,t1y,cx+ux*fd+nx*sp,cy+uy*fd+ny*sp,cx+ux*fd-nx*sp,cy+uy*fd-ny*sp,t2x,t2y].join(',')
    };
  }

  function redAlpha(){
    if(tab==='lunar'&&prog>35&&prog<65) return Math.max(0,1-Math.abs(50-prog)/15);
    return 0;
  }

  function getStatus(){
    if(tab==='solar'){
      if(prog<30) return 'The Moon orbits toward the space between Earth and the Sun. Its shadow misses Earth entirely.';
      if(prog<45) return 'Partial Eclipse Begins: The lighter penumbra shadow touches Earth — mild dimming for viewers.';
      if(prog<55) return 'Total Eclipse! The dark umbra sweeps across Earth. Day turns to night for those in the path.';
      if(prog<70) return 'Partial Eclipse Ending: The umbra moves off Earth, only the penumbra remains.';
      return 'Eclipse Over: The Moon moves out of alignment and its shadow no longer touches Earth.';
    } else {
      if(prog<25) return 'The Moon approaches Earth\'s large shadow, currently fully illuminated by the Sun.';
      if(prog<40) return 'Partial Eclipse Begins: The Moon enters Earth\'s umbra — a curved dark bite appears on its surface.';
      if(prog<60) return 'Total Eclipse! The Moon is fully engulfed in the umbra. Refracted sunlight gives it a blood-red glow.';
      if(prog<75) return 'Partial Eclipse Ending: The Moon slowly exits the darkest shadow.';
      return 'Eclipse Over: The Moon is fully out of the shadow and returns to its normal brightness.';
    }
  }

  function drawMain(){
    var m=moonPos();
    var es=getShadow(EX,CY,ER,800,120,1000);
    var ms=getShadow(m.x,m.y,MR,260,80,800);
    var ra=redAlpha();
    var eOp=tab==='lunar'?1:0.1;
    var h='<defs>'
     +'<filter id="ecl-f1" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">'
     +'<feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="15" result="b"/>'
     +'<feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>'
     +'</filter>'
     +'<linearGradient id="ecl-eg" x1="0%" x2="100%">'
     +'<stop offset="10%" stop-color="#3b82f6"/><stop offset="50%" stop-color="#1e40af"/><stop offset="90%" stop-color="#0f172a"/>'
     +'</linearGradient>'
     +'<linearGradient id="ecl-mg" x1="0%" x2="100%">'
     +'<stop offset="20%" stop-color="#e2e8f0"/><stop offset="80%" stop-color="#334155"/>'
     +'</linearGradient>'
     +'</defs>'
     +'<rect width="1000" height="400" fill="#030712"/>'
     +'<circle cx="80" cy="50" r="1" fill="#fff" opacity=".5"/>'
     +'<circle cx="200" cy="320" r="1.5" fill="#fff" opacity=".8"/>'
     +'<circle cx="350" cy="80" r="1" fill="#fff" opacity=".3"/>'
     +'<circle cx="450" cy="280" r="1" fill="#fff" opacity=".6"/>'
     +'<circle cx="550" cy="150" r="1.5" fill="#fff" opacity=".7"/>'
     +'<circle cx="120" cy="200" r="1" fill="#fff" opacity=".4"/>'
     +'<circle cx="280" cy="370" r="1" fill="#fff" opacity=".5"/>'
     +'<circle cx="620" cy="60" r="1" fill="#fff" opacity=".3"/>'
     +'<circle cx="820" cy="120" r="1" fill="#fff" opacity=".6"/>'
     +'<circle cx="900" cy="300" r="1.5" fill="#fff" opacity=".4"/>'
     +'<ellipse cx="'+EX+'" cy="'+CY+'" rx="'+OR+'" ry="'+OR+'" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 6" opacity=".4"/>'
     +'<circle cx="-20" cy="'+CY+'" r="120" fill="#fbbf24" filter="url(#ecl-f1)"/>'
     +'<g opacity="'+eOp+'">'
     +'<polygon points="'+es.p+'" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.08)"/>'
     +'<polygon points="'+es.u+'" fill="rgba(0,0,0,0.7)"/>'
     +'</g>'
     +'<circle cx="'+EX+'" cy="'+CY+'" r="'+ER+'" fill="url(#ecl-eg)"/>';
    if(tab==='solar'){
      h+='<polygon points="'+ms.p+'" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.15)"/>'
        +'<polygon points="'+ms.u+'" fill="rgba(0,0,0,0.85)"/>';
    }
    h+='<circle cx="'+m.x+'" cy="'+m.y+'" r="'+MR+'" fill="url(#ecl-mg)"/>';
    if(ra>0) h+='<circle cx="'+m.x+'" cy="'+m.y+'" r="'+MR+'" fill="#991b1b" opacity="'+ra.toFixed(2)+'"/>';
    h+='<text x="50" y="380" fill="#fbbf24" font-size="18" opacity=".7">Sun</text>'
      +'<text x="'+( EX-18)+'" y="'+( CY+ER+22)+'" fill="#60a5fa" font-size="16">Earth</text>'
      +'<text x="'+( m.x-15)+'" y="'+( m.y+MR+18)+'" fill="#cbd5e1" font-size="13">Moon</text>';
    if(tab==='solar'){
      h+='<text x="770" y="190" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="11">Umbra</text>'
        +'<text x="800" y="250" fill="#64748b" font-size="11">Penumbra</text>';
    } else {
      h+='<text x="800" y="180" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="11">Earth\'s Umbra</text>'
        +'<text x="830" y="255" fill="#64748b" font-size="11">Penumbra</text>';
    }
    document.getElementById('ecl-svg').innerHTML=h;
  }

  function drawPip(){
    var m=moonPos(), yOff=(m.y-CY)*0.45;
    var ra=redAlpha();
    var h='';
    if(tab==='solar'){
      var a=Math.max(0.1,1-Math.abs(50-prog)/10).toFixed(2);
      h='<rect width="100" height="100" fill="rgba(14,165,233,'+a+')"/>'
       +'<circle cx="50" cy="50" r="25" fill="#fbbf24"/>'
       +'<circle cx="50" cy="'+( 50+yOff).toFixed(1)+'" r="25.5" fill="#0f172a"/>';
    } else {
      var c=ra>0?'#b91c1c':'#e2e8f0';
      h='<rect width="100" height="100" fill="#020617"/>'
       +'<circle cx="50" cy="50" r="35" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.05)"/>'
       +'<circle cx="50" cy="50" r="20" fill="rgba(0,0,0,0.8)"/>'
       +'<circle cx="50" cy="'+( 50+yOff).toFixed(1)+'" r="10" fill="'+c+'"/>';
    }
    document.getElementById('ecl-pip').innerHTML=h;
  }

  function update(){
    drawMain();
    drawPip();
    document.getElementById('ecl-status').textContent=getStatus();
  }

  function step(ts){
    if(t0===0) t0=ts;
    var dt=ts-t0; t0=ts;
    prog=Math.min(100,prog+dt*0.005);
    document.getElementById('ecl-slider').value=prog;
    update();
    if(prog<100&&playing) raf=requestAnimationFrame(step);
    else if(prog>=100){playing=false;document.getElementById('ecl-play-btn').innerHTML='&#9654;';}
  }

  window.eclTogglePlay=function(){
    playing=!playing;
    document.getElementById('ecl-play-btn').innerHTML=playing?'&#9646;&#9646;':'&#9654;';
    if(playing){t0=0;raf=requestAnimationFrame(step);}
    else if(raf){cancelAnimationFrame(raf);}
  };

  window.eclReset=function(){
    playing=false;
    if(raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    prog=0;
    document.getElementById('ecl-play-btn').innerHTML='&#9654;';
    document.getElementById('ecl-slider').value=0;
    update();
  };

  window.eclOnSlider=function(v){
    playing=false;
    if(raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    document.getElementById('ecl-play-btn').innerHTML='&#9654;';
    prog=parseFloat(v);
    update();
  };

  window.eclSetTab=function(t){
    tab=t; prog=0; playing=false;
    if(raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    document.getElementById('ecl-play-btn').innerHTML='&#9654;';
    document.getElementById('ecl-slider').value=0;
    var s=document.getElementById('ecl-btn-solar');
    var l=document.getElementById('ecl-btn-lunar');
    s.style.background=t==='solar'?'#6366f1':'transparent';
    s.style.color=t==='solar'?'white':'#94a3b8';
    l.style.background=t==='lunar'?'#6366f1':'transparent';
    l.style.color=t==='lunar'?'white':'#94a3b8';
    update();
  };

  update();
})();
</script>
```

# Myth or Fact?

```{=html}
<div id="moon-myths" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1a1a2e 0%,#16213e 50%,#0f3460 100%); color:white; padding:30px; border-radius:16px; margin:30px 0; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);">

    <button id="mmf-fact" onclick="mmfAnswer('Fact')" style="flex:1; padding:14px; border:none; border-radius:10px; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#00b894,#00cec9); color:white; font-size:1em; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 4px 15px rgba(0,184,148,0.3);">✅ FACT</button>

  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function() {
  var cards = [
    {
      text: "Moon phases are caused by Earth's shadow falling on the Moon.",
      type: "Myth",
      explanation: "Earth's shadow causes a lunar eclipse — a rare event. Moon phases happen every month and are caused by our changing viewing angle as the Moon orbits Earth. The illuminated half always faces the Sun; what changes is how much of it we can see."
    },
    {
      text: "\"Spring tides\" only happen in the spring season (March–May).",
      type: "Myth",
      explanation: "The term 'spring' comes from the Old English word springan meaning 'to leap' — not the season. Spring tides happen every ~2 weeks, at every New Moon and Full Moon, year-round, whenever the Sun and Moon are gravitationally aligned."
    },
    {
      text: "A Full Moon occurs when Earth is approximately between the Sun and Moon.",
      type: "Fact",
      explanation: "Correct! At Full Moon, Earth sits between the Sun and the Moon, so the Moon's entire sunlit face points directly toward us. This is why we see a fully illuminated disk — and why the Full Moon always rises around sunset."
    },
    {
      text: "The Moon produces its own light that brightens and dims each month.",
      type: "Myth",
      explanation: "The Moon produces no light of its own. It reflects about 12% of the sunlight that hits it (its albedo). The Moon's surface brightness stays constant — what changes is how much of the lit side is visible from Earth as it orbits."
    },
    {
      text: "The timing of Hurricane Sandy's landfall during a New Moon made its flooding significantly worse.",
      type: "Fact",
      explanation: "Sandy made landfall October 29, 2012 — a New Moon spring tide. The already-elevated baseline tide added roughly 1–2 extra feet to the storm surge. The Battery gauge recorded a record ~14 ft surge. During a neap tide instead, total flood heights would have been measurably lower."
    },
    {
      text: "Solar eclipses don't happen every New Moon primarily because the Moon is sometimes too far from Earth.",
      type: "Myth",
      explanation: "Distance variation (apogee/perigee) affects eclipse type (total vs. annular), but the PRIMARY reason eclipses are rare is the Moon's 5° orbital tilt. Most months the Moon passes above or below the Sun–Earth line; only when a New or Full Moon coincides with an orbital node does an eclipse occur (~2–5 times per year)."
    },
    {
      text: "During a First or Third Quarter Moon, exactly half of the Moon's surface is illuminated by the Sun.",
      type: "Fact",
      explanation: "At Quarter Moons, the Moon is 90° from the Sun as seen from Earth, so we see exactly half the illuminated face. They're called 'quarters' because the Moon has completed one-quarter (or three-quarters) of its full orbit — not because only a quarter is lit."
    },
    {
      text: "Neap tides are dangerous because the water level drops to extremely low levels.",
      type: "Myth",
      explanation: "Neap tides produce the smallest tidal range — moderate highs and moderate lows, not dangerous extremes. The real coastal hazard comes from spring tides (New and Full Moon), which produce the highest high tides. A spring-tide baseline dramatically amplifies storm surge flooding."
    }
  ];
  var idx = 0, score = 0, answered = 0, cardAnswered = false;
  function updateCard() {
    if (idx >= cards.length) {
      document.getElementById('mmf-card').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('mmf-myth').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('mmf-fact').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('mmf-feedback').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('mmf-next').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('mmf-done').style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('mmf-final').textContent = score;
      return;
    }
    document.getElementById('mmf-card').textContent = cards[idx].text;
    document.getElementById('mmf-progress').textContent = 'Card ' + (idx + 1) + ' of ' + cards.length;
    document.getElementById('mmf-feedback').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('mmf-next').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('mmf-myth').disabled = false;
    document.getElementById('mmf-fact').disabled = false;
    document.getElementById('mmf-myth').style.opacity = '1';
    document.getElementById('mmf-fact').style.opacity = '1';
    cardAnswered = false;
  }
  window.mmfAnswer = function(choice) {
    if (cardAnswered) return;
    cardAnswered = true;
    answered++;
    var card = cards[idx];
    var correct = (choice === card.type);
    if (correct) score++;
    document.getElementById('mmf-score').textContent = score;
    document.getElementById('mmf-total').textContent = answered;
    var fb = document.getElementById('mmf-feedback');
    fb.style.display = 'block';
    fb.style.background = correct ? 'rgba(0,184,148,0.2)' : 'rgba(214,48,49,0.2)';
    fb.style.border = '1px solid ' + (correct ? '#00b894' : '#e17055');
    fb.innerHTML = '<strong>' + (correct ? '✅ Correct! ' : '❌ That\'s a ' + card.type + '! ') + '</strong>' + card.explanation;
    document.getElementById('mmf-myth').disabled = true;
    document.getElementById('mmf-fact').disabled = true;
    document.getElementById('mmf-myth').style.opacity = (choice === 'Myth') ? '1' : '0.5';
    document.getElementById('mmf-fact').style.opacity = (choice === 'Fact') ? '1' : '0.5';
    document.getElementById('mmf-next').style.display = 'block';
  };
  window.mmfNext = function() { idx++; updateCard(); };
  window.mmfRestart = function() {
    idx = 0; score = 0; answered = 0;
    document.getElementById('mmf-card').style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('mmf-myth').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('mmf-fact').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('mmf-done').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('mmf-score').textContent = '0';
    document.getElementById('mmf-total').textContent = '0';
    updateCard();
  };
  updateCard();
})();
</script>
```

# End-of-Chapter Quiz

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function buildUnitQuiz(id, title, questions) {
  const outer = html`<div id="${id}" style="font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; max-width:720px; margin:18px auto;"></div>`;
  const header = html`<div style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea 0%,#764ba2 100%);color:#fff;border-radius:14px 14px 0 0;padding:18px 24px;">
    <div style="font-size:1.1em;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;"><span style="font-size:1.2em;">📝</span> ${title}</div>
    <div style="font-size:0.85em;opacity:0.85;margin-top:4px;">Select an answer for each question.</div>
  </div>`;
  const body = html`<div style="border:1.5px solid #c7d2fe;border-top:none;border-radius:0 0 14px 14px;overflow:hidden;background:#f8f9ff;padding:16px;"></div>`;
  questions.forEach((qq, qi) => {
    const card = document.createElement("div");
    card.style.cssText = "background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:16px 20px;margin-bottom:14px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.08);";
    card.innerHTML = `<p style="font-weight:700;margin:0 0 10px;color:#1e1b4b;">${qi+1}. ${qq.q}</p>`;
    qq.options.forEach((opt, oi) => {
      const btn = document.createElement("button");
      btn.textContent = opt;
      btn.style.cssText = "display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:10px 14px;margin:6px 0;border:2px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;color:#1e1b4b;cursor:pointer;font-size:.95em;transition:border-color .2s,background .2s;";
      btn.onmouseover = () => { if(!card.dataset.answered){ btn.style.borderColor="#667eea";btn.style.background="#f0f0ff"; }};
      btn.onmouseout  = () => { if(!card.dataset.answered){ btn.style.borderColor="#e2e8f0";btn.style.background="#fff"; }};
      btn.onclick = () => {
        if(card.dataset.answered) return;
        card.dataset.answered = "true";
        card.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => {
          b.style.cursor="default"; b.onmouseover=null; b.onmouseout=null;
          b.style.borderColor="#e2e8f0"; b.style.background="#f8fafc"; b.style.color="#475569";
        });
        if(oi === qq.correct){
          btn.style.borderColor="#48bb78";btn.style.background="#f0fff4";btn.style.color="#276749";btn.style.fontWeight="700";
          fb.innerHTML = "✅ Correct! " + qq.explanation;
          fb.style.color="#276749";fb.style.background="#f0fff4";
        } else {
          btn.style.borderColor="#fc8181";btn.style.background="#fff5f5";btn.style.color="#9b2c2c";btn.style.fontWeight="700";
          const correctBtn = card.querySelectorAll("button")[qq.correct];
          correctBtn.style.borderColor="#48bb78";correctBtn.style.background="#f0fff4";correctBtn.style.color="#276749";correctBtn.style.fontWeight="700";
          fb.innerHTML = "❌ " + qq.explanation;
          fb.style.color="#9b2c2c";fb.style.background="#fff5f5";
        }
        fb.style.padding="10px 14px";fb.style.marginTop="8px";fb.style.borderRadius="8px";
      };
      card.appendChild(btn);
    });
    const fb = document.createElement("div");
    fb.style.cssText = "border-radius:8px;font-size:.9em;transition:all .3s;";
    card.appendChild(fb);
    body.appendChild(card);
  });
  outer.appendChild(header);
  outer.appendChild(body);
  return outer;
}
```

```{ojs}
    ],
    correct: 2,

])
```
